description: This file defines the RequiredDataHandler Java interface, which serves as a super interface for all handlers responsible for setting required data on OpenmrsObjects during save, void, or retire actions within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: RequiredDataHandler
classes.description: A generic interface for handling the setting of required data on OpenmrsObject instances during various lifecycle events such as saving, voiding, or retiring.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Method to set required data on the given OpenmrsObject, invoked during save, void, or retire actions, with context about the current user, date, and optional parameters.
